name: Kent Plantation House

dates.altered: Moved a few blocks to its present site in January 1964 after the American Legion gave it up (Great American Treasures page); the loc.gov catalogue prints '1880' among its structure dates.
dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox and the node's exemplar say 1800 (Wikipedia names Pierre Baillio II); the house's own site says 'built circa 1795'; the loc.gov sheet says 'Competed in 1800'. Recorded as the register has it.
